title: Sharp systolic inequalities for Kähler manifolds
summary: We establish sharp inequalities for two-dimensional systolic invariants of metrics with positive scalar curvature: the $2$-systole and the spherical $2$-systole of compact Kähler manifolds, and the stable $2$-systole of Riemannian metrics on a general class of $\mathrm{spin}^c$ manifolds and their products. These bounds attain equality precisely for complex projective space $\mathbb{CP}^n$ equipped with the Fubini--Study metric, and admit further refinements for Fano manifolds which distinguish the complex quadric, cubic, and quartic with their canonical Kähler--Einstein structures.
